title: Dhanvantri Medical Camp
summary: RCB Mega Medical Camp: A Resounding Success!
description:
RCB Mega Medical Camp:
A Resounding Success!

Rotary Club of Borivli, in association with Rotary District 3141 team, successfully organized a *Mega Medical Camp on 6th September 2026, at Hudson CHSL, Vasai East.*

This impactful community service project was *spearheaded by our distinguished PP Rtn. Manish Gyani* and ably supported by our *President Rtn. Aarti Parekh.*

The project was enthusiastically and flawlessly executed by our extremely dedicated and competent member *Rtn. Dr. Kanak Ganguly*, who spared no efforts in ensuring its seamless planning, coordination and on-ground execution.

*Scope of the Camp:*
The Medical Camp offered *Free of Cost* comprehensive health check-ups and diagnostic tests including CBC, Blood Sugar, Blood Pressure, Total Cholesterol, TSH Thyroid, and Vitamin D & B12, along with Dental Check-ups and Basic Eye Check-ups.

*Satisfactory Outcomes:*

*1.* A total of *146 beneficiaries and 35 children* availed the free health services and left highly satisfied.
*2.* Free toothpaste samples were distributed to all beneficiaries to promote oral hygiene.
*3.* Special counselling on the benefits of quitting tobacco chewing was provided to several individuals found to be addicted and suffering from its adverse effects.

*Our Heartfelt Thanks to:*

*1. PP Rtn. Manish Gyani and Rtn. Dr. Kanak Ganguly* – For their visionary leadership and tireless efforts in making this camp a grand success.

*2. Rtn. Dharti Joshi (Avenue Director – Medical)* – For her excellent support and coordination.

*3. Dr. Jasmit Desai (Indian Dental Association, Mumbai Suburban Branch) and Dr. Yuga Desai* – On special request of Dr. Kanak Ganguly, both doctors volunteered selflessly and tirelessly examined a large number of patients, including children, throughout the day.

*4. Ms. Gayatri, Mr. Jayprakash and the Office Bearers & Members of Hudson CHS, Vasai* – For graciously hosting us and extending all logistical support at the venue.

The combined efforts, teamwork and spirit of service of all involved truly exemplified *Service Above Self* and resulted in the resounding success of this Mega Medical Camp.
